input.answer: I'd go with Harel, the track that looks like their S&P 500 one: 0.56% fee, 13.7% a year over 3 years and 11.92% over 5. Harel is a big name I know, and for the S&P that's the lowest fee with the best 5-year number I saw. Fairly sure, but I never actually saw that card's title clearly (it was cut off between two screens). I only know it's the S&P because its numbers look like Mor's "עוקב מדד S&P500".
